title: The bracket width for Lie algebras of vector fields is finite
summary: We prove that the bracket width of the Lie algebra of vector fields on any smooth affine algebraic variety of dimension $n$ is at most $(n+1)^2$. We give improved bounds for some families of $\mathbb{C}^*$-varieties, in particular for $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ and for the Koras--Russell cubic threefold.
